confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, listings or price data were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from the beer anchor (about 2x and 1.5x) because direct knowledge is weak. Accommodation is least certain given tax treatment, area variation and regional conditions after the June 2026 knowledge cutoff; no off-season discount assumed for July. FX value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rate table, cross-checked against an OFX historical figure; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Basis is general Middle East mid-sized capital tourist-hotel pricing, with Downtown, Jabal Amman, Abdoun and Rainbow Street as assumed visitor areas; alcohol prices reflect Jordan's high alcohol taxation.
